title: Let the heart be kept in what is complete
summary: This meets the chronic sense that something essential is missing. The line says the path, cleansing, peace, and honor become whole when Naam lives in the heart.
takeaway: Take shelter in what is complete.
lifeApplication: When you feel unfinished and start hunting for another fix, pause and return to the Name already given. Let completeness grow from sanctuary, not frantic patching.

source.shortMeaning: Everything becomes whole when the Name is kept in the heart.
source.lifeApplication: In the feeling of lack, take shelter and return to the Name before grasping again.

evidence.coreClaim: Everything becomes whole when the Name is kept in the heart.
evidence.turn: Wholeness begins when the Name is kept in the heart.
evidence.practicalImplication: When you feel unfinished and start hunting for another fix, pause and return to the Name already given. Let completeness grow from sanctuary, not frantic patching.
